notes.title: "Cyber Loop" Temporarily Suspends Demo Testing Notice
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992215/57008eedf5d61fb9269a22f433d3b690f4225d2e.png[/img]
Dear players, thank you for your enthusiasm and participation in "Cyber Loop". During the testing period from May 1st to May 10th, we collected a lot of valuable feedback and found some issues and shortcomings. In order to bring you a better gaming experience, we have decided to temporarily take down the Demo test and focus on optimization and improvement. Please be patient and wait for us to share the latest game progress and launch time with you as soon as possible. Thank you again for your understanding and support!

notes.title: An Apology Statement Regarding the English Version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44992215/161434359b809497e62e1355993dc2813a365960.png[/img]We indicated on the page that the English version is supported, but in the trial version, we failed to upload the English support, causing inconvenience to all players. We wholeheartedly apologize for this.
We will add support for the English version in the next update.
Once again, we offer our sincere apology.

notes.title: TPS Roguelike game "Cyber Loop" free trial demo is now online
notes.notes:
"Cyber Loop" combines TPS shooting & Roguelike mechanics in a survival adventure. As amnesiac Thomas, explore randomized mazes, uncover dark secrets. Intense battles, unpredictable worlds, & custom gear create unique gameplay. Add to Steam Wishlist; embark on a post-apocalyptic odyssey!
